# Amazon Berkeley Objects (c) by Amazon.com

Canned excerpt for the CPU tests of `wenart/assets/abo.py` (docs/milestone8.md §2): the licence and attribution
sections of `3dmodels/README.md` of [Amazon Berkeley Objects](https://amazon-berkeley-objects.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html)
(read on 4 Oct 2026), next to 38 listings of `listings/metadata/listings_*.json.gz` (trimmed to the fields the
survey reads: one English and one other item name, style, colour, material, brand) and their rows of
`3dmodels/metadata/3dmodels.csv.gz` (one row left out on purpose: the `no_model_row` case). The data is unchanged
otherwise and remains under the licence below.
